jobs.job_title: Technical Sales Engineer / Technical Product Manager – RF Electronic Test Measurement | Mejdaf | Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
jobs.job_description:
Position Summary:

Mejdaf is actively seeking an experienced, high-caliber, and technically strong Technical Sales Engineer / Technical Product Manager specializing in RF Electronic Test Measurement to join our Telecom Business Unit team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia on a full-time permanent on-site basis. In this critical customer-facing and technical leadership role, you will be responsible for understanding complex applications, conducting technical demonstrations, and translating advanced technical requirements into practical RF measurement solutions. You will leverage your deep specialist expertise in radio frequency technologies, wireless communications, and electronic test and measurement systems to deliver uncompromised pre-sales support, customer satisfaction, and business growth. This opportunity offers competitive compensation, executive technical visibility, and exceptional career growth prospects within a premier regional technology solutions enterprise.

Detailed Job Description:

As a Technical Sales Engineer / Technical Product Manager supporting the Telecom Business Unit at Mejdaf in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, you will take full operational, tactical, and technical ownership of pre-sales engineering, technical product management, client demonstrations, and RF test solution design. Your day-to-day responsibilities include analyzing complex technical customer requirements, recommending appropriate RF measurement solutions, conducting technical product demonstrations, engaging confidently with engineers and technical specialists, evaluating high-frequency circuit characterization, and providing expert pre-sales support. You will utilize your proactive problem-solving and bilingual communication skills to bridge complex engineering challenges with commercial success under strict performance standards.

Key Responsibilities:

• Provide expert pre-sales technical support, product management, and solution engineering for RF electronic test and measurement systems.

• Analyze complex customer technical requirements and recommend appropriate electronic test and measurement hardware and software solutions.

• Conduct compelling technical demonstrations, proof-of-concept tests, and presentations for engineers, managers, and key stakeholders.

• Engage confidently with technical specialists, clarifying signal characteristics, frequency-domain analysis, modulation, and spectrum occupancy.

• Evaluate high-frequency circuit characterization, signal integrity, electronic circuit testing, and hardware fault diagnosis.

• Coordinate cross-functional with internal product development, commercial sales, and engineering support squads.

• Maintain rigorous technical product documentation, competitive product matrices, and pre-sales tender response archives.

• Author meticulous technical proposals, product datasheets, pre-sales evaluation reports, and customer demonstration summaries.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

• Bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Minimum of 2 to 5+ years of progressive professional experience in technical sales, application engineering, or customer-facing technical support.

• Strong understanding of RF and microwave engineering principles, signal characteristics, frequency-domain analysis, modulation, spectrum occupancy, interference mechanisms, RF propagation, and electromagnetic field measurement.

• Solid knowledge of wireless communication systems, RF troubleshooting methodologies, and techniques for identifying and analyzing signal interference.

• Proven ability to analyze technical requirements, recommend appropriate measurement solutions, and conduct high-impact technical demonstrations.

• Fluency in both Arabic and English (written and spoken) for effective client communication across the Saudi market.

• Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, technical presentation, and interpersonal communication capabilities.

• Mandatory legal work eligibility in Saudi Arabia and availability for full-time on-site operations in Riyadh.

Nice-to-Have Skills:

• Advanced understanding of high-frequency circuit characterization, signal integrity, electronic circuit testing, and fault diagnosis.

• Practical hands-on experience utilizing advanced RF test and measurement solutions (Spectrum Analyzers, Network Analyzers, Signal Generators).

• Knowledge of fiber-optic communications, optical transmission principles, fiber-optic testing methodologies, and optical network troubleshooting.

• Familiarity with electronic testing technologies associated with ABI and Huntron diagnostic equipment.

• Prior professional working experience in technical sales or product management within the telecommunications sector in GCC markets.

Application Information:

• Recruiter: Mejdaf Human Resources & Telecom Business Unit Division

• Contact Name: Mejdaf Recruitment Team (Mai Alharbi / Mejdaf Management)

• Email: m.alharbi@mejdaf.com

• Phone:

• Company Website: https://www.mejdaf.com

• Salary/Rate: Market Competitive / Saudi Operations Enterprise Package

• Deadline: Open until filled (Urgent Riyadh Telecom BU Opening)

• Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days

• Contract Duration: Permanent / Full-Time On-Site (Riyadh, Saudi Arabia - Telecom BU)

Recruitment Pro Tip:

• When applying for this Technical Sales Engineer / Technical Product Manager position at Mejdaf, ensure your resume explicitly highlights your hands-on RF test and measurement expertise, your client-facing technical presentation portfolio, and your bilingual proficiency in Arabic and English.

jobs.job_title: Senior Vice President POM Product Management
jobs.job_description:
About the Role

BNY is seeking a Regional Product, Data & Solutions Lead, Middle East & Africa to join its Data & Analytics team, the fintech arm of the company. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with responsibilities extending across the broader Middle East and Africa region. The role involves serving as the national and regional representative, product advocate, and technical solutions lead for BNY’s Data & Analytics portfolio.
Role Responsibilities

The successful candidate will combine product leadership, pre-sales engineering, data expertise, and regulatory awareness to identify opportunities, engage customers, shape solutions, and translate regional requirements into global product priorities. Key responsibilities include:
• Acting as the KSA National regulatory and data representative, monitoring emerging regulatory, data-residency, security, cloud, and compliance requirements across the Middle East and Africa. This involves collaborating with Risk, Legal, Compliance, Data Governance, and Technology teams to assess product implications and ensure solutions are appropriate for regional clients and markets.
• Serving as the regional product and solutions representative for clients and prospects, engaging directly with customers to understand their business and data challenges, and communicating the capabilities, value propositions, and product roadmaps of BNY’s Data & Analytics solutions.
• Driving regional product adoption and execution by working across organizational boundaries to advance opportunities. This includes supporting field teams, coordinating product and data dependencies, developing reusable solution patterns and documentation, building regional partnerships, and converting client feedback into scalable product capabilities.
• Owning and advocating for the regional product strategy, identifying market opportunities, competitive dynamics, client needs, and regional priorities. This involves partnering with global product managers, engineering teams, Product Solutions, Sales, Services, and Support to influence roadmaps, prioritize execution, and ensure regional requirements are addressed.
• Supporting technical pre-sales activities, including product demonstrations, presentations, Requests for Information, Requests for Proposal, solution design sessions, and proofs of concept. This requires hands-on work with sample data, SQL, cloud platforms, APIs, and product configurations to demonstrate how BNY solutions meet specific customer requirements.
Required Qualifications and Experience

Candidates should possess over 10 years of relevant experience. A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is required. The role also demands the ability to travel regularly within the region and to BNY’s global offices.
Key Skills
• A client-focused and entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities, communicate a compelling product vision, develop practical solutions, and provide hands-on support for sales pursuits, demonstrations, proofs of concept, implementation planning, and client adoption.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. This includes the ability to present to senior client and internal audiences, influence without direct authority, balance regional autonomy with global alignment, and collaborate effectively across Product, Engineering, Sales, Services, Operations, Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Data Governance teams.
Company and Location

This role is with BNY, located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is part of the Data & Analytics team. The position is full-time.

jobs.job_description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Manager, Payments Infrastructure based in Saudi Arabia.
As a Product Manager, Payments Infrastructure, you will shape the core systems that enable secure, reliable, and scalable money movement across multiple markets and currencies. You will own the technical roadmap for payment processing, settlement, ledger systems, virtual accounts, and banking integrations. Working closely with Engineering, Product, Treasury, and Compliance, you will ensure transactions are processed accurately, efficiently, and on time. You will help optimize payment routing, liquidity management, and cross-border settlement across traditional banking and stablecoin networks. This role offers the opportunity to influence critical infrastructure decisions in a fast-moving fintech environment serving emerging markets. You will combine technical product expertise with strategic thinking to strengthen system resilience, expand payment capabilities, and support sustainable growth.
Accountabilities
Own and execute the technical roadmap for core payment infrastructure, including payment rails, ledger systems, settlement engines, currency conversion, and virtual account capabilities.
Lead the development of virtual accounts and Virtual IBAN infrastructure to support customer-facing payment experiences and evolving business needs.
Collaborate with the Payment Experience Product Manager to align infrastructure capabilities with customer requirements and translate upcoming product needs into technical priorities.
Evaluate, prioritize, and oversee integrations with banking partners, liquidity providers, and stablecoin settlement networks, balancing cost, speed, reliability, and market coverage.
Own transaction processing, settlement, and reconciliation systems to ensure accurate, timely, and reliable movement of funds across multiple currencies and payment networks.
Define payment routing and currency conversion strategies, selecting the most appropriate rails for individual transactions and supporting settlement through networks such as USDC, USDT, and PYUSD.
Partner with Engineering on architecture decisions involving APIs, distributed systems, data consistency, idempotency, error handling, and reconciliation.
Work with Treasury to incorporate liquidity requirements, funding models, and payment corridor coverage into infrastructure design.
Collaborate with Compliance to embed regulatory, licensing, and market-specific requirements into payment infrastructure from the outset.
Define and monitor infrastructure performance metrics, including transaction success rates, settlement times, system uptime, reconciliation accuracy, and incident frequency and severity.
Work with Engineering on capacity planning, incident response, scalability improvements, and the prioritization of technical debt that could affect reliability or future growth.
Document infrastructure capabilities, limitations, partner integrations, and corridor-specific requirements to support Product, Engineering, and go-to-market teams.
Requirements
At least 5 years of Product Management experience, including 3 or more years working with payment infrastructure, payment rails, ledger systems, or core banking and transaction platforms within fintech or crypto.
Strong technical fluency, with the ability to engage in detailed architecture discussions covering APIs, distributed systems, data consistency, transaction processing, and system reliability.
A bachelor's or master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Product Management, or a related field.
Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken.
Experience collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams across different disciplines, markets, and time zones.
Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage competing demands, meet deadlines, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated ability to make informed trade-offs between speed, cost, scalability, and reliability when defining technical product priorities.
Experience with stablecoin or cryptocurrency settlement networks is a plus.
Experience integrating banking partners, working with correspondent banking networks, or managing cross-border payment rails is a plus.
Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to explain complex infrastructure capabilities and technical constraints to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Benefits
Meaningful impact:
Contribute to expanding financial inclusion and improving access to financial infrastructure across emerging markets.
Remote-first flexibility:
Work in a fully remote environment.
International collaboration:
Join a diverse, multicultural team of professionals working across more than 25 countries.
Learning and development:
Access resources, support, and autonomy to develop your skills and advance your career.
Mental health support:
Benefit from services designed to support your mental well-being.
Competitive compensation:
Receive a competitive compensation package aligned with the role and experience.
Health coverage:
Access meaningful healthcare benefits.
Equity participation:
Participate in the stock option plan available to full-time employees.
Full-time opportunity:
Take ownership of critical payment infrastructure initiatives with opportunities to influence technical strategy and long-term product development.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
